measurement.observed_useful_span_definition: last_meaningful_progress_at - substantive_work_started_at; diagnostic only, not proof of continuous work
measurement.continuous_progress_rule: Only evidenced useful intervals count. Sparse timestamps do not imply work between them.
measurement.window_useful_coverage_definition: sum of evidenced useful intervals inside the intended 900-second window, excluding unexplained gaps and known idle/waiting
measurement.dead_tail_definition: successor_observed_at - predecessor_last_meaningful_progress_at when both are known
measurement.target_operating_model: >=840s evidenced useful coverage per intended 900s window

latest_completed_turn.reason: A real plan existed and completed its declared implementation substeps, but policy-required related continuation did not produce further durable progress. No evidence permits counting the 00:33:25-00:46:08 gap as useful work.

latest_diagnosis.evidence: Epoch 16 had a machine-valid ACTIVE plan and CI-successful implementation, yet meaningful progress ended after 145 seconds and did not resume before the successor observed it stale.
latest_diagnosis.secondary_risk: Repository policy can detect and recover worker death but cannot itself manufacture background execution or a new wake before the scheduler/runtime provides one.

next_corrective_experiment.hypothesis: Separating wake source, reasoning-worker lifetime, durable continuation and measurement will prevent false utilization claims and reveal whether the dominant remaining gap is application logic or runtime substrate.
next_corrective_experiment.change: Adopt runtime-continuity metrics and RUNTIME_INVOCATION_ENDED_EARLY classification; optimize meaningful checkpoint density and test whether a coherent larger objective materially extends invocation useful span.
next_corrective_experiment.success_signal: Epoch 17 produces materially longer evidenced useful coverage than epoch 16 while retaining resumability; if it still ends early, preserve the measured boundary and target the wake/runtime adapter rather than adding policy prose.
